description: Lila, a home baker with one limited batch of decorated cookies, must decide whether to accept a florist's barter proposal and settle the exact exchange, handoff, and packaging terms after checking the arrangement with the people involved.

shared_context.S1: Lila has one limited batch of 72 decorated cookies available for a weekend gathering.
shared_context.S2: Lila decides whether to accept an offer and sets the final terms of the arrangement.
shared_context.S3: Noor is a local florist, and Evan is also interested in obtaining the cookie batch.
shared_context.S4: Lila's normal practice before committing a special-order batch is for each participant to use the deal-sheet reveal step to submit exact offer, use, timing, and handling terms; spoken discussion alone is not treated as a formal term.
shared_context.S5: For this batch, Lila will accept an arrangement only if its cash component is at least $230, and she would value receiving one hand-tied bouquet for an upcoming family celebration.
shared_context.S6: Lila prefers to settle the quantity, payment or exchange, pickup timing, and packaging terms explicitly before agreeing to a special-order batch.
shared_context.S7: Before confirming the arrangement, Lila writes down the final terms and the reasons supporting her choice.

PF1.text: Noor's exact deal-sheet submission is one hand-tied bouquet plus $240 cash in exchange for exactly 72 cookies, with Noor collecting them on Saturday at 10:00. Noor also submits that every cookie must be individually sealed and accompanied by an ingredient card because the event caterer reported a guest with a peanut allergy; this packaging requirement is non-negotiable for Noor's event.

PF2.text: Evan's exact deal-sheet submission is a confirmed cash offer of exactly $220 from a nearby cafe for the same 72-cookie batch, with no bouquet or barter involved.

acceptance_conditions: The accepted trade partner must be Noor.
The settlement must cover exactly 72 cookies, one bouquet, and a $240 cash adjustment.
Noor must collect the cookies on Saturday at 10:00.
The settlement must record the competing cash offer as exactly $220.
Every cookie must be individually sealed.
Ingredient cards must be included with the cookies.
The settlement must include a commitment whose details state that every cookie is individually sealed.
The settlement must include a commitment whose details state that ingredient cards accompany the cookies.
The decision-maker must cite Noor's exact deal-sheet terms and Evan's competing cash offer when explaining the decision.

content_checks.C6: any('individually sealed' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('ingredient card' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Noor's revealed deal-sheet submission changes the accepted partner, fixes 72 cookies, one bouquet, $240 cash, Saturday 10:00 pickup, and the two exact packaging requirements.
Evan's revealed deal-sheet submission changes the comparison record from an unknown alternative to a confirmed competing cash offer of exactly $220.
